svg.title: S1. Simulated contract histories
svg.text: S1. What each theory world looks like, contract by contract
18 amended contracts drawn at random from each simulated world. Each row is a contract; each dot an amendment, placed at its time in the original term; dot area = amendment size.
B. Design: scope gaps, no lock-in
Shaded: first quarter of the term (where implementation-stage gaps surface) and the last 10% through extension (where renewals land).
Read: B front-loads amendments; in C amendments grow as dependence builds and contracts are extended past term; D adds renewals regardless of history; A: some contracts are just busier.
